title: Analysis code and processed data for "ARGK-2 sets a transcriptional stress response baseline in Caenorhabditis elegans"
description:
Analysis code and processed data accompanying Dunivan & Fausett, G3: Genes|Genomes|Genetics (2026).

A full-factorial bulk RNA-seq experiment comparing Caenorhabditis elegans N2 (wild type), argk-2(ok2723) (RB2060) and argk-4(ok3602) (RB2598) under acute CoCl2 oxidative stress, with orthogonal qPCR validation. The archive contains the complete numbered analysis pipeline (R and Python), processed count matrices, sample metadata, offline GO/KEGG/TFLink annotation resources, all DESeq2 contrast tables, gene-regulatory-network node and edge tables, and every published figure with its source data.

Raw sequencing reads are deposited separately at NCBI GEO under accession GSE333535.
